name: The Devil's Frying Pan
overview: An adventurous four-episode detective series filled with twists, humor, and New Year's magic. During the finale of the popular cooking show “The Devil's Frying Pan”, a mysterious murder takes place. Police captain Orest Petimko must find the killer before the end of the year in order to earn a promotion and give his daughter an unforgettable holiday. Soon, every member of the production crew becomes a suspect.
